# truefoundry_gateway_data_routing_config (Resource)

Manages the AI gateway data routing configuration: where the gateway's observability data is stored — control-plane-managed or customer-managed blob storage, with per-request routing rules. Applied as a `gateway-data-routing-config` manifest via `PUT /api/svc/v1/apply`. **The data routing config is a tenant-wide singleton** — define at most one of this resource per control plane; an apply replaces the whole config. Import the existing config with `terraform import truefoundry_gateway_data_routing_config.example gateway-data-routing-config`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The tenant-wide AI gateway data routing config (singleton — define at most one):
# where the gateway's observability data (traces, metrics) is stored.
resource "truefoundry_gateway_data_routing_config" "routing" {
  name = "datarouting"

  # Everything not matched below goes to control-plane-managed storage.
  default = {
    storage = {
      type = "controlplane-managed"
    }
  }

  destinations = [
    # Data of one gateway cluster lands in our own blob storage.
    {
      name    = "my-cluster"
      enabled = true

      when = [
        {
          field  = "metadata"
          key    = "tfy_gateway_cluster"
          values = ["my-cluster"]
        },
      ]

      storage = {
        type                    = "customer-managed"
        storage_integration_fqn = "my-tenant:azure:my-blobstorage:blob-storage:my-container"
      }

      traces_retention_period_days = 30
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `default` (Attributes) Storage for data not matched by any destination. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default))
- `name` (String) Name of the data routing config (3-32 characters, lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens).

### Optional

- `destinations` (Attributes List) Routes for matching requests, evaluated before the default. Omit the attribute (rather than an empty list) when everything goes to the default. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the gateway data routing config.

<a id="nestedatt--default"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default`

Required:

- `storage` (Attributes) Where the data is stored. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default--storage))

Optional:

- `traces_retention_period_days` (Number) How many days traces are retained.

<a id="nestedatt--default--storage"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default.storage`

Required:

- `type` (String) Storage kind. One of: `controlplane-managed`, `customer-managed`.

Optional:

- `region` (String) Region for controlplane-managed storage (not allowed otherwise). One of: `us`, `australia`, `india`.
- `storage_integration_fqn` (String) Blob storage integration FQN for customer-managed storage (required there, not allowed otherwise), e.g. my-tenant:azure:my-blobstorage:blob-storage:my-container.



<a id="nestedatt--destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destinations`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the destination is active.
- `name` (String) Name identifying this destination, unique within the config.
- `storage` (Attributes) Where the data is stored. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations--storage))
- `when` (Attributes List) Conditions a request must match (all of them) to be routed here. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations--when))

Optional:

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the destination.
- `traces_retention_period_days` (Number) How many days traces are retained.

<a id="nestedatt--destinations--storage"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destinations.storage`

Required:

- `type` (String) Storage kind. One of: `controlplane-managed`, `customer-managed`.

Optional:

- `region` (String) Region for controlplane-managed storage (not allowed otherwise). One of: `us`, `australia`, `india`.
- `storage_integration_fqn` (String) Blob storage integration FQN for customer-managed storage (required there, not allowed otherwise), e.g. my-tenant:azure:my-blobstorage:blob-storage:my-container.


<a id="nestedatt--destinations--when"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destinations.when`

Required:

- `field` (String) Request property to match. One of: `metadata`, `created_by`.
- `values` (List of String) Values to match against (IN semantics).

Optional:

- `key` (String) Metadata key to match (required for `metadata` conditions, not allowed otherwise).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The data routing config is a tenant-wide singleton; its import ID is the
# fixed string "gateway-data-routing-config".
terraform import truefoundry_gateway_data_routing_config.routing gateway-data-routing-config
```
